title: A done mission must prove its work branch is on the remote
goal: Observed: a mission reported done and pushed its close receipt while its work branch was never pushed - it was behind origin/main, and no step failed the task for it, so the accepted work sat only in the harness worktree. Before reporting a task done the adapter must sync the worktree and push the branch, and treat a refused push as the task's failure (the reason recorded), not as success; the receipt alone is not proof that the work is publishable.
